tooltips.volume: Base playback volume. Random offsets, curves, mixgroup gain and volume convars can modify the final level.
tooltips.delay: Delay in seconds before the event starts playing.
tooltips.pitch: Base playback-rate multiplier. 1.0 is normal pitch and speed; random pitch offsets can be added to it.
tooltips.volume_random_min: Minimum random offset added to the base volume each time a track is selected.
tooltips.volume_random_max: Maximum random offset added to the base volume each time a track is selected.
tooltips.pitch_random_min: Minimum random offset added to the base pitch each time a track is selected.
tooltips.pitch_random_max: Maximum random offset added to the base pitch each time a track is selected.
tooltips.randomize_position_min_radius: Minimum radius, in Source units, for the random position offset generated when the event starts.
tooltips.randomize_position_max_radius: Maximum radius, in Source units, for the random position offset generated when the event starts.
tooltips.retrigger_interval_min: Minimum delay in seconds before a retriggered event plays again.
tooltips.retrigger_interval_max: Maximum delay in seconds before a retriggered event plays again.
tooltips.occlusion_intensity: Strength of geometry occlusion. 0 disables occlusion attenuation; 1 applies the full blocked-sound attenuation.
tooltips.distance_effect_mix: Controls how much of the stack distance-effect processing is applied to the sound.
tooltips.reverb_wet: Controls the environmental reverb wet amount used by the event sound stack.
tooltips.occlusion_frequency_scale: Scales the frequency-dependent part of occlusion, changing how strongly blocked sound is filtered.
tooltips.vsnd_duration: Cached duration of the referenced VSND in seconds. Usually generated by tools and normally not something to tune by hand.
tooltips.block_duration: How long, in seconds, a matching instance of this event is blocked after this event starts.
tooltips.block_distance: Maximum spatial distance used when blocking matching instances. 0 commonly means no distance restriction.
tooltips.instance_limit: Maximum number of matching event instances allowed by the limiter. 0 is commonly used when no explicit limit is wanted.
tooltips.reverb_source_wet: Controls the source-side wet amount used when the stack calculates the final reverb send.
tooltips.distance_multiplier: Multiplier applied to listener distance before distance-based curves are evaluated.
tooltips.broadcast_distance_override: Override the distance used by the event broadcast or observer propagation path.
tooltips.block_other_duration: How long, in seconds, events matched by Block Other Name are blocked.
tooltips.block_other_distance: Maximum distance within which events matched by Block Other Name are blocked.
tooltips.velocity_volume_seek_speed: Smoothing speed used when the velocity-driven volume value moves toward its target.
tooltips.ducking_bypass: Bypasses the engine's ducking attenuation so it would never be lowered by intense firefights, flashbang tinnitus, or voice chat.
tooltips.retrigger_radius: Retrigger only while the listener is inside this radius. Values at or below 0 disable the radius requirement.
tooltips.self_destruct_time: Automatically drives the event toward stop or fade after this many elapsed seconds. Negative values disable the timer.
tooltips.value: Generic numeric value used by setter-style sound-event stacks. Its exact meaning depends on the event Type.
tooltips.dsp_bypass: Routes the sound toward the DSP-bypass path instead of the normal processed or reverb paths.
tooltips.occlusion_interval: Time interval, in seconds, between occlusion updates or traces.
tooltips.retrigger_count: Maximum number of retriggers when finite retriggering is used. -1 means unlimited.
tooltips.dsp_blend: Controls the blend used by the event DSP processing. Negative values can be used by stacks as a default or override state.
tooltips.voice_culling_threshold: Volume threshold below which the engine can cull an inaudible voice to reduce processing cost.
tooltips.volume_fade_out_input_max: Duration, in seconds, of the CS:GO music stop fade.
tooltips.priority: Priority used when a CS:GO music track competes in the music track queue. Higher-priority tracks can win over lower ones.
tooltips.volume_fade_initial_input_min: Start of the elapsed-time range used by the CS:GO music initial-volume remap.
tooltips.volume_fade_initial_input_max: End of the elapsed-time range used by the CS:GO music initial-volume remap.
tooltips.volume_fade_initial_input_map_min: Output gain produced at the start of the CS:GO music initial-volume remap.
tooltips.volume_fade_initial_input_map_max: Output gain produced at the end of the CS:GO music initial-volume remap.
tooltips.startpoint_01: Start or pre-roll time in seconds for music track 1 when it is started or queued.
tooltips.startpoint_02: Start or pre-roll time in seconds for music track 2 when it is started or queued.
tooltips.startpoint_03: Start or pre-roll time in seconds for music track 3 when it is started or queued.
tooltips.endpoint_01: Optional loop or restart endpoint in seconds for music track 1. 0 lets the stack use the full VSND duration.
tooltips.endpoint_02: Optional loop or restart endpoint in seconds for music track 2. 0 lets the stack use the full VSND duration.
tooltips.endpoint_03: Optional loop or restart endpoint in seconds for music track 3. 0 lets the stack use the full VSND duration.
tooltips.sync_action_to_startround: Use the globally remembered StartRound track index so this music event selects the matching variation instead of a random track.
tooltips.stop_at_time: Automatically stop this sound event when its elapsed time reaches this value in seconds. Negative values disable it.
tooltips.restart_startpoint_01: Time in seconds to restart music track 1 from when a loop or restart occurs.
tooltips.restart_startpoint_02: Time in seconds to restart music track 2 from when a loop or restart occurs.
tooltips.vsnd_files_track_01: VSND file or list used by csgo_mega. When multiple files are supplied, the stack selects one for playback.
tooltips.vsnd_files: VSND file or list used by csgo_music and related stacks. Multiple entries can be selected according to the stack selection rule.
tooltips.position: Authored world position for the sound event. [0, 0, 0] is commonly a placeholder when the caller or entity supplies the real position.
tooltips.position_offset: Offset added to the sound source position before spatialization.
tooltips.enable_child_events: Allow this event to start the Soundevent 01 child event or child-event list.
tooltips.enable_retrigger: Enable periodic replay using Retrigger Interval Min/Max and the other retrigger settings.
tooltips.restrict_source_reverb: Restrict how source-side reverb contributes to the final event reverb calculation.
tooltips.randomize_position_hemisphere: Limit the random position offset to the positive-Z hemisphere instead of a full sphere.
tooltips.use_distance_unfiltered_stereo_mapping_c: Enable the distance-based curve that controls the unfiltered-stereo or spread amount.
tooltips.use_distance_volume_mapping_curve: Enable the distance-to-volume curve for attenuation.
tooltips.override_dsp_preset: Use this event DSP Preset instead of the normal inherited or environment preset.
tooltips.set_child_position: Pass the parent event position to child sound events so they play from the same source.
tooltips.position_relative_to_player: Use the listener/player position as the base source position instead of the source entity or authored world position.
tooltips.use_world_position: Tell the sound stack to use the authored or world-position path for source placement.
tooltips.block_matching_events: Block repeated instances of this same event according to Block Duration, Block Distance and Block Match Entity.
tooltips.block_match_entity: When blocking matching events, require the source entity to match the current event source entity.
tooltips.use_fadetime_volume_mapping_curve: Enable the fade-time-to-volume curve used while the event is stopping or fading.
tooltips.use_entity_position_if_local_player: If the source is the local player, use the source entity position for spatial placement.
tooltips.display_broadcast: Enable CS2 broadcast or observer-oriented sound propagation behavior for this event.
tooltips.use_baked_occlusion: Use baked occlusion or path data for this event instead of relying only on live occlusion behavior.
tooltips.preload_vsnds: Request the referenced VSND assets be preloaded so first playback does not have to load them on demand.
tooltips.use_impact_speed_input_volume_mapping_cu: Enable the impact-speed-to-volume curve for physics-driven sounds.
tooltips.set_mixlayer_amount_enable: Enable time-driven control of a named sound-mixer layer.
tooltips.block_other: Block other events whose names match Block Other Name, using the configured duration and distance.
tooltips.use_velocity_volume_curve: Enable velocity-driven volume control using the Velocity Volume Curve.
tooltips.use_velocity_eq: Enable velocity-driven EQ or filter behavior in sound stacks that support it.
tooltips.use_volume_convar: Multiply event volume by the current value of Volume Convar.
tooltips.stop_selection_music: Stop currently playing music events whose names begin with Music.Selection.
tooltips.stop_all_non_music: Stop matching non-Music sound events when this music event starts.
tooltips.stop_music: Stop other sound events whose names begin with Music. when this event starts.
tooltips.vsnd_pause_with_game: Pause the VSND voice when the game is paused.
tooltips.is_ui_sound: Treat the event as a UI/local sound for positioning and routing decisions.
tooltips.use_uiposition: Enable listener-relative positioning using a UI-position vector expressed along the listener left, forward and up axes.
tooltips.position_offset_relative: Rotate or orient Position Offset relative to the source entity before applying it.
tooltips.use_time_unfiltered_stereo_mapping_curve: Enable the elapsed-time curve controlling the unfiltered-stereo or spread amount.
tooltips.use_doppler: Enable Doppler pitch shifting from relative source and listener motion.
tooltips.join_non_mvp_group: Add this event to the non-MVP music group so Stop Music Except Mvp can stop it as a group.
tooltips.priority_override: Make the music track queue use this event Priority value instead of the queue or default priority.
tooltips.loop_track: Loop or restart the selected music track. Endpoint and Restart Startpoint can define the loop boundary and restart position.
tooltips.should_queue_track: Use the synchronized CS:GO music track queue instead of starting the track independently.
tooltips.update_track_syncpoint_index: Store the selected music variation index globally and use its sync-point field when queueing, so related music events can stay aligned.
tooltips.stop_music_except_mvp: Stop the shared non-MVP music group, leaving MVP music outside that group untouched.
tooltips.skip_if_muted: Do not start the music stack when its selected volume convar is effectively zero.
tooltips.test_mvp_block: Check whether this MVP or music event is currently blocked before allowing it to play.
tooltips.check_for_classic_deathcam: If music or death-camera volume is effectively muted, start the classic Player.FreezeCam fallback sound event.
tooltips.stop_won_mvp: Stop Music.WonRound, Music.LostRound and Music.MVPAnthem events. The current stack behavior is broader than the key name suggests.
tooltips.block_won_lost: Create untimed blocks for Music.WonRound and Music.LostRound so those events cannot start while the block is active.
tooltips.occlusion: Legacy or stack-specific occlusion toggle. For current csgo_mega behavior, Occlusion Intensity and Use Baked Occlusion are the clearer controls.
tooltips.dsp_preset: DSP or reverb preset to use when Override Dsp Preset is enabled.
tooltips.soundevent_01: Child sound event name or list started by this event when Enable Child Events is enabled.
tooltips.mixgroup: Mixer group used for event gain, routing and DSP behavior.
tooltips.type: Selects the sound-event operator stack or implementation. Common CS2 types include csgo_mega for spatial events and csgo_music for music playback.
tooltips.base: Inherits all properties from another sound event. Properties declared in the current event will override same-named properties in the parent. Enter the target base event name in this input (e.g. Base.Event or Weapon_Base).
tooltips.set_mixlayer_layer: Name of the mixer layer whose amount is driven by Time Mixlayer Amount Curve.
tooltips.block_other_name: Event-name substring matched by Block Other.
tooltips.volume_convar: Console variable whose current value scales the event volume.
tooltips.mixlayer_name: Name of a mixlayer targeted by setter-style sound-event types such as core_setter_AHR_mixlayer_amount.
tooltips.distance_volume_mapping_curve: Maps listener distance, after Distance Multiplier, to a volume multiplier.
tooltips.fadetime_volume_mapping_curve: Maps stop or fade elapsed time to a volume multiplier.
tooltips.distance_unfiltered_stereo_mapping_curve: Maps listener distance to the amount of unfiltered stereo or spread used by the spatializer.
tooltips.time_volume_mapping_curve: Maps event elapsed time to a volume multiplier.
tooltips.impact_speed_input_volume_mapping_curve: Maps the supplied physics impact-speed input to a volume multiplier.
tooltips.time_mixlayer_amount_curve: Maps event elapsed time to the amount applied to Set Mixlayer Layer.
tooltips.velocity_volume_curve: Maps source or input velocity to a volume multiplier.
tooltips.time_unfiltered_stereo_mapping_curve: Maps event elapsed time to the amount of unfiltered stereo or spread.
tooltips.syncpoints_01: Ordered sync-point times, in seconds, for music track 1. The CS:GO music queue uses them to align transitions and related tracks.
tooltips.syncpoints_02: Ordered sync-point times, in seconds, for music track 2. The CS:GO music queue uses them to align transitions and related tracks.
tooltips.syncpoints_03: Ordered sync-point times, in seconds, for music track 3. The CS:GO music queue uses them to align transitions and related tracks.
tooltips.uiposition: Listener-relative left/forward/up position vector. Paired with Use Uiposition.
tooltips.distance_pitch_mapping_curve: Maps listener distance to a pitch multiplier.
tooltips.occlusion_path_curve: Baked-occlusion path curve used when Use Baked Occlusion is enabled.
tooltips.impact_speed_input: Input value consumed by Impact Speed Input Volume Mapping Curve.
tooltips.velocity_magnitude: Velocity input exposed by the current sound stack.
tooltips.voice_looped_culling_update_time: Update interval for culling looped voices.
tooltips.randomize_start_time: Randomizes the initial seek/start time within the VSND.
tooltips.restart_startpoint_03: Third csgo_music restart startpoint, alongside Restart Startpoint 01 and 02.
tooltips.source_soundscape: Soundscape source referenced by the event stack.
tooltips.retrigger_keepalive_override: Retrigger lifetime/keepalive override used by the csgo_mega stack.
tooltips.suppression_enable: Enables weapon silencer suppression logic, reducing volume and audible range when suppressed.
tooltips.suppression_volume_multiplier: Volume multiplier applied when suppressor is attached (official standard: 0.07).
tooltips.suppression_falloff_multiplier: Distance falloff multiplier applied when suppressor is attached (official standard: 0.2).
tooltips.use_ambient_entity_position: Positions ambient sound at the coordinates or bounding box of a specified map entity (such as snd_event_orientedbox, snd_event_sphere, or snd_event_point).
tooltips.ambient_entity_name: Target entity name in the map to bind ambient sound emission.
tooltips.vsnd_selection_type: Selection mode for multiple vsnd files (random, random_weighted, round_robin, sequential).
tooltips.vsnd_weights: Weight array corresponding to vsnd files when using random_weighted selection.
tooltips.use_mode_music_volume: Whether track volume respects game mode music volume settings.
tooltips._auto_calc_vnsd_duration_: Compiler flag: if false, preserves specified vsnd_duration without recalculation.
tooltips.metadata: Array of engine metadata tags for this sound event, e.g. ['meta', 'localplayeronly'].

csgo_mega.name: Generic 3D Spatial Audio (csgo_mega)
csgo_mega.desc: Core CS2 spatial audio stack (~90% of all official sounds). Ideal for 3D world entities, weapon gunfire/reloading, explosions, footsteps, grenade bounces, standard ambient sounds, and any audio requiring distance attenuation, occlusions, and environmental reverb.

csgo_music.name: Interactive Track System (csgo_music)
csgo_music.desc: Official interactive music system. Designed for main menu tracks, round start/end, MVP anthems, bomb plant countdowns, and 10-second warnings. Supports beat-aligned syncpoints, smooth crossfades, round-state stopping, and weighted track variations.

csgo_ambient.name: Entity Ambience Soundscape (csgo_ambient)
csgo_ambient.desc: Multi-stage entity ambience stack. Binds via ambient_entity_name to map sound entities (such as snd_event_orientedbox, snd_event_sphere, or snd_event_point), ideal for waterfalls, wind tunnels, vents, or mechanical hums requiring complex multi-range attenuation curves, spatial reverb, and position randomization.

csgo_surf.name: Surf & Velocity Slide (csgo_surf)
csgo_surf.desc: Dynamic velocity-driven surface physics. Modulates volume and frequency equalization (EQ) in real time based on player movement velocity. Designed for surf on ramps, surface friction and water skimming sounds.

csgo_movie.name: Panorama Movie Audio (csgo_movie)
csgo_movie.desc: Panorama UI movie audio container. Designed for playing accompanied soundtrack audio in Panorama UI WebM/MP4 video popups and background cinematic playback.

guideModal.title: CS2 Map Sound Entity Guide

concept.title: Core Concept: Relationship Between SoundEvents and Map Entities
concept.p1: SoundEvent (in .vsndevts files) is the sound's "configuration template and algorithmic core", defining volume, 3D distance falloff curves, spatial reverb, and geometric occlusion.
concept.p2: Entities are the map's "3D sound origin and playback controllers", responsible for providing world coordinates, responding to trigger logic (I/O), and tracking model movement.

entities.name: snd_event_point
entities.mechanism: Radiates omnidirectionally from the entity's single point coordinates.
entities.scenario: Button interaction sounds, generators, sirens, switch sound effects.

entities.name: snd_event_sphere
entities.mechanism: Configured with radius; the emission origin dynamically snaps to the closest point on the sphere surface to the player.
entities.scenario: Large spherical fireballs, dome reactor cores, large rotating spherical machinery.

entities.name: snd_event_orientedbox
entities.mechanism: Configured with width, length, and height bounds; emission origin dynamically projects to the closest contact surface of the box to the player.
entities.scenario: Elongated rivers, large waterfall water curtains, underground ventilation ducts, open water surfaces.

entities.name: snd_event_cone
entities.mechanism: Features orientation and cone angles; crisp and loud from the front, muffled by damping and low-pass filtering from behind.
entities.scenario: Megaphones, air raid sirens, spotlight-style directional loudspeakers.

entities.name: snd_event_path_corner
entities.mechanism: Moves continuously and smoothly along the map's path corner network.
entities.scenario: Fighter jets roaring across the sky, subway trains rushing along underground tracks.

entities.name: snd_opvar_set_*
entities.mechanism: Does not emit sound directly. Dynamically modifies variables inside the SoundEvent based on player distance.
entities.scenario: Adjusts low-pass cutoff frequencies or ambient mix transitions as the player approaches specific zones.
entities.io: Automatically updates OpVars based on distance.

steps: Configure & Copy: Adjust properties or select a preset in this generator, then click the "📋 Copy" button in the right toolbar.
Paste into File: Locate your CS2 addon directory: game/csgo_addons/<your_addon>/soundevents/soundevents_addon.vsndevts, paste the copied content at the end of the file, and save.
Place Entity in Hammer: Place a sound entity in your map (such as snd_event_point), and enter your event name (e.g. Weapon_Custom.Single) in its Sound Event Name (or soundName) entity property.
Logic Linkage (I/O): For button interaction, add an Output on the trigger entity (such as func_button): OnPressed -> Your Sound Entity -> StartSound.
Test & Debug: Compile the map in Hammer, launch the CS2 client, and enter the map to test audio effects. You can also run play <SoundEventName> directly in the console to trigger and test.
